title: Sapa vs Ha Giang: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Ha Giang for the most dramatic mountain adventure in Asia. Sapa for flexible trekking, luxury accommodation options, and easier logistics. Do both if you have 10+ days.

categories.name: Scenery Drama
categories.summary: Ha Giang's Ma Pi Leng Pass and karst plateau are in a different category from Sapa's beautiful-but-conventional terraced valleys.

categories.name: Cultural Authenticity
categories.summary: Ha Giang is raw and genuinely unfiltered. Sapa town is heavily touristy; authentic encounters require venturing far from town.

categories.name: Accommodation Options
categories.summary: Sapa has luxury resorts, mid-range hotels, hostels, and trek homestays. Ha Giang is basic guesthouses only.

categories.name: Accessibility
categories.summary: Sapa has overnight train option from Hanoi. Ha Giang is bus-only with no train service.

categories.name: Time Flexibility
categories.summary: Sapa works for 2-day visits. Ha Giang requires 3-4 days minimum for the loop.

categories.name: Physical Activity
categories.summary: Sapa is foot trekking; Ha Giang is motorcycle riding. Different skill sets, both physically demanding.

faq.question: Is Sapa or Ha Giang better for first-timers?
faq.answer: Sapa for first-timers. Ha Giang for adventurous travelers who can commit 3-4 days.

faq.question: Which is cheaper?
faq.answer: Ha Giang guided loop $169-199 USD for 3D2N all-in. Sapa $24-36/day for guided trekking plus accommodation.
